output.note: Derivation per the pinned Solana sources: SHA-256 over seeds (declared order) then the bump byte then the program id then the bytes "ProgramDerivedAddress" (solana-labs/solana sdk/program/src/pubkey.rs at 7700cb3128c1f19820de67b81aa45d18f73d2ac0, create_program_address L585-L616); a result that decompresses to an Ed25519 curve point can never be a program-derived address, reported as on_curve. The canonical bump scan follows try_find_program_address (L510-L545) and its successor (anza-xyz/solana-sdk address/src/derive.rs): candidate bumps run 255 down to 1 and the first off-curve result wins, so bump 0 is outside the search space and a claimed bump of 0 is non-canonical even when its recomputed address matches; the row gloss that said 255 to 0 is corrected here per the primary text. Limits: at most 16 seeds including the bump seed, each seed at most 32 bytes (MAX_SEEDS 16, MAX_SEED_LEN 32), restated as facts, never silently dropped. ATA derivation uses seeds [wallet, token program id, mint] under program ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA8knL (solana-program/associated-token-account at 4004274dfb861e09570af873b46cb0b0919e8df0, interface/src/address.rs L67-L74); the classic-program side by side uses TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA, and token_program_mismatch is true exactly when the mint is declared under Token-2022 (TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb, spl-token-2022-interface 3.1.2 src/lib.rs L29) and the two addresses differ, the wrong-derivation class the pinned ATA source itself deprecates. Off-curve testing is @noble/curves ed25519 point decompression. All comparisons are string equality on pasted values; this kernel reads nothing on-chain.
